items.title: Zelensky sacks Ukraine's top army commander after days of protests
items.description: Oleksandr Syrskyi is dismissed after backlash over the removal of popular Defence Minister Mykhailo Fedorov.

items.title: Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal
items.description: A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.

items.title: Carney looking at 'all options' as Trump announces 50% tariffs on Canada
items.description: The duties mark a major escalation in trade tensions between the North American neighbours.

items.title: Dozens hurt in Bologna protests after man dies while being restrained by police
items.description: Thousands of people took to the streets demanding justice for a Moroccan-born man who died on Sunday.

items.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
items.description: Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.

items.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill 12, including family of six, medics say
items.description: Firas al-Masri, his wife and their four children died in one attack, which the Israeli military says targeted a Hamas operative.

items.title: Two French firefighters die tackling blaze near Bordeaux airport
items.description: The blaze close to the parking lots at Bordeaux-Mérignac Airport is said to have originated from a brush fire.

items.title: Brazil's Amazon sees sharp decline in size of area burned in 2025
items.description: The amount of land burned in the world's largest rainforest was the smallest since MapBiomas records began in 1985.

items.title: Shock and anger after top Ghanaian politician sentenced to 20 years for illegal mining
items.description: Bernard Antwi Boasiako, known as "Chairman Wontumi", was also fined more than $10,000 (£7,450).

items.title: 'Anti-ICE' army veteran started fire outside Manhattan federal building, say officials
items.description: Andrew Arrabaca, 43, was armed with two axes, a machete, three knives and fireworks, says the FBI.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' protest continues a day after police crackdown
items.description: Delhi witnessed overwhelming violence on Monday, with at least 60 protesters wounded. Police said 118 of their men were also injured.

items.title: Police officers arrested for allegedly seeking roadside bribe from Nigeria's anti-corruption boss
items.description: They are accused of stopping Musa Aliyu at a fake roadblock and telling him to drive to a cash machine.
